title: datetime.utcnow is deprecated
summary: Python 3.12 deprecates datetime.datetime.utcnow() and says to use timezone-aware objects to represent datetimes in UTC.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

steps.title: Use an aware datetime
steps.instructions: Replace datetime.utcnow() with datetime.now(datetime.UTC); the result is timezone-aware, so check comparisons with naive datetimes.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
